dedupe_keys.name: pysolorie clear sky solar orientation model

description: pysolorie estimates clear-sky solar exposure and selects a fixed collector tilt. Its developers provide Python calculations based on the Hottel model, using latitude, altitude, climate type and day to estimate direct solar energy. The README demonstrates a location-based workflow and exports reports in CSV, JSON or XML. Geographic coverage is determined by the supplied site coordinates, while daily calculations and the chosen period define temporal detail. The model can prepare solar-resource assumptions for related building or electricity design simulations. Source access is free under Apache-2.0 and the current documentation requires Python 3.9 or newer. A limitation is that clear-sky direct radiation does not represent actual cloud variability or complete photovoltaic electricity output. Panel efficiency, shading, diffuse radiation treatment and system losses need separate attention for a full installation study. No weather observations were downloaded and no site-specific energy yield was validated.
name: pysolorie clear-sky solar orientation model
notes: G5 G5-0272. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
outputs: Optimised fixed tilt and CSV, JSON or XML reports
